description: Arapoint AI Support Knowledge Base - Covers all Arapoint services, FAQs, common issues, and resolutions.

entries.question: What is Arapoint?
variations: what can arapoint help me with
entries.answer: Arapoint is Nigeria's trusted identity and utility verification platform. We offer NIN/BVN lookup, JAMB/WAEC/NECO/NABTEB/NBAIS result checking, education services, VTU (airtime, data, bills), Airtime-to-Cash conversion, wallet funding, and CAC business registration services. We are designed to make verification and utility services fast, reliable, and affordable.

entries.question: How do I contact Arapoint support?
entries.answer: You can reach Arapoint support directly through this chat by clicking 'Talk to Agent' or typing 'agent'. You can also submit a support ticket, and our team will respond within 24 hours. We are available Monday to Saturday, 8am to 8pm WAT.

entries.question: What are Arapoint's working hours?
entries.answer: Arapoint operates Monday to Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (WAT). Our AI assistant is available 24/7. For urgent issues outside business hours, please submit a ticket and an agent will respond first thing in the morning.

entries.question: How do I create an account on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To create an Arapoint account: 1) Visit our website and click 'Sign Up', 2) Enter your full name, email address, and phone number, 3) Create a strong password, 4) Verify your email address using the OTP sent to you, 5) You're ready to use all Arapoint services.

entries.question: How do I reset my password?
entries.answer: To reset your password: 1) Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, 2) Enter your registered email address, 3) Check your email for the password reset link (check spam if not found), 4) Click the link and create a new password. If you still cannot access your account after this, please contact support.

entries.question: My account is locked, what do I do?
entries.answer: Account locks usually happen after multiple failed login attempts as a security measure. Please wait 30 minutes and try again. If your account is still locked or has been suspended, please contact our support team — an agent will investigate and restore access for you.

entries.question: How do I update my profile information?
entries.answer: You can update your profile by going to 'My Account' or 'Settings' after logging in. You can update your name, phone number, and other details. Note that changing your registered email address may require verification via OTP.

entries.question: What is NIN?
entries.answer: NIN stands for National Identification Number. It is an 11-digit unique number assigned to every Nigerian citizen and legal resident by the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC). It is used to verify your identity for financial, legal, and government services.

entries.question: How do I look up a NIN on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To look up a NIN on Arapoint: 1) Fund your wallet or use pay-as-you-go, 2) Go to 'Identity Verification' > 'NIN Lookup', 3) Enter the 11-digit NIN number, 4) Click 'Verify'. Results are returned instantly and include the holder's name, date of birth, gender, and photo.

entries.question: My NIN lookup returned 'not found', what should I do?
entries.answer: If your NIN lookup shows 'not found': 1) Double-check that you entered exactly 11 digits, 2) Ensure there are no spaces or extra characters, 3) Confirm the NIN is valid (you can check via the NIMC app or *346#), 4) If the NIN is correct but still not found, the record may not be in our database yet — please contact support with the NIN for manual investigation.

entries.question: How do I get my NIN slip PDF?
entries.answer: To get your NIN slip PDF: 1) Go to 'Identity Verification' > 'NIN Slip', 2) Enter your NIN, 3) Pay the processing fee, 4) Your PDF slip will be generated and available for download immediately. The slip is an A4-sized document you can print.

entries.question: What is vNIN and how do I get it?
entries.answer: A vNIN (Virtual NIN) is a temporary, tokenized version of your NIN used to link your phone number to your NIN without exposing your actual NIN. To get a vNIN on Arapoint: 1) Go to 'Identity Verification' > 'vNIN Generation', 2) Enter your NIN, 3) Pay the fee, 4) Your vNIN will be generated instantly. Each vNIN is valid for 72 hours.

entries.question: How much does NIN lookup cost?
entries.answer: NIN lookup pricing is shown on the service page before you confirm. The fee varies by service type (basic lookup, full verification, NIN slip, vNIN). Please check the current prices on the Identity Verification page. All fees are clearly displayed before payment.

entries.question: What is BVN?
entries.answer: BVN stands for Bank Verification Number. It is an 11-digit unique number issued by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) to every bank customer. It links all your bank accounts and is used to verify your identity for banking and financial services.

entries.question: How do I look up a BVN on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To look up a BVN on Arapoint: 1) Go to 'Identity Verification' > 'BVN Lookup', 2) Enter the 11-digit BVN number, 3) Click 'Verify'. Results include the holder's name, date of birth, phone number (masked), and bank accounts linked.

entries.question: BVN lookup returned not found, what do I do?
entries.answer: If your BVN is not found: 1) Confirm the BVN is exactly 11 digits, 2) Check by dialing *565*0# on your registered bank phone number to see your BVN, 3) Ensure you're entering the correct number without spaces. If it's still not found, contact support — the BVN may not be in our current database or may require manual verification.

entries.question: How do I download my BVN report PDF?
entries.answer: After a successful BVN lookup, you will see a 'Download PDF' button on the results page. Click it to download your BVN verification report as a PDF. This report includes all verified details from the BVN record.

entries.question: How do I check my JAMB result on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To check your JAMB result: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'JAMB Result Checker', 2) Enter your JAMB registration number (format: 12345678AB), 3) Select the exam year, 4) Pay the fee and click 'Check'. Your result showing all subject scores and total will be displayed.

entries.question: JAMB result not showing or not found
entries.answer: If your JAMB result is not showing: 1) Verify your registration number format (should be 8 digits followed by 2 letters, e.g., 12345678AB), 2) Confirm the exam year you selected is correct, 3) Some results take up to 48 hours to appear after JAMB releases them. If the issue persists, please contact our support team with your registration number.

entries.question: How do I check JAMB admission status?
variations: how to know if I was admitted
entries.answer: To check your JAMB admission status: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'JAMB Admission Status', 2) Enter your JAMB registration number, 3) Select the exam year, 4) Click 'Check'. The result will show whether you've been offered admission, which institution, and the course.

entries.question: How do I change my JAMB course or institution?
variations: jamb change of course and institution
entries.answer: For JAMB change of course/institution: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'JAMB Change of Course/Institution', 2) Submit your registration number and requested changes, 3) Our JAMB agent will process it through the JAMB CAPS portal, 4) You'll be notified once completed. Note: JAMB change of course has specific windows — ensure you are within the approved period.

entries.question: What is JAMB direct entry and how do I process it?
variations: how to register for direct entry
entries.answer: JAMB Direct Entry (DE) is for candidates who already have OND, HND, NCE, A-Level, or other equivalent qualifications and want to gain university admission at 200 level. To process DE on Arapoint: submit your request in 'Education Services' > 'JAMB Direct Entry', provide your qualifications and preferred institution/course, and our agent will handle the JAMB portal registration.

entries.question: How do I get my JAMB admission letter?
entries.answer: To get your JAMB admission letter: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'Admission Letter', 2) Enter your JAMB registration number, 3) Our agent processes the request through the JAMB portal, 4) The official admission letter PDF is uploaded for you to download. This letter is needed for your school registration.

entries.question: What is JAMB regularization and mutation?
entries.answer: JAMB Regularization is for students who gained admission without proper JAMB authorization (e.g., admitted for a different course or year). Mutation is for correcting errors in your JAMB result or details. Both processes require JAMB agent intervention. Submit your request through 'Education Services' and provide all required documents.

entries.question: How do I check my WAEC result on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To check your WAEC result: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'WAEC Result Checker', 2) Enter your exam number (e.g., 4120101001), 3) Select your exam year and type (SSCE, GCE), 4) Pay the verification fee, 5) Your result will be displayed showing all subjects and grades.

entries.question: My WAEC result is not found
entries.answer: If your WAEC result is not found: 1) Ensure your exam number is correct (check your scratch card or WAEC statement of result), 2) Confirm the exam year and exam type (SSCE or GCE), 3) WAEC results for recent exams may take a few weeks to be released. If the issue persists, contact our support team.

entries.question: How do I check my NECO result on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To check your NECO result: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'NECO Result Checker', 2) Enter your exam number, 3) Select your exam year and exam type (SSCE/JCE), 4) Pay the fee, 5) Your grades for all subjects will be displayed instantly.

entries.question: How do I check my NABTEB result?
entries.answer: To check your NABTEB result: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'NABTEB Result Checker', 2) Enter your NABTEB examination number, 3) Select the exam year, 4) Pay the fee and click 'Check'. Your NABTEB technical result will be displayed.

entries.question: How do I check my NBAIS result?
entries.answer: To check your NBAIS result: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'NBAIS Result Checker', 2) Enter your examination number, 3) Select the year and level, 4) Pay the applicable fee, 5) Your result will be shown. NBAIS covers Islamic education results.

entries.question: How do I buy airtime on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To buy airtime: 1) Go to 'VTU Services' > 'Airtime', 2) Select the network (MTN, Airtel, Glo, 9mobile), 3) Enter the phone number to recharge, 4) Enter the amount (minimum ₦50), 5) Confirm the purchase. Airtime is delivered instantly. Your wallet will be debited.

entries.question: How do I buy data bundle on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To buy a data bundle: 1) Go to 'VTU Services' > 'Data', 2) Select the network, 3) Enter the phone number, 4) Choose a data plan from the list, 5) Confirm the purchase. Data is activated on the phone instantly. All major networks and plan sizes are available.

entries.question: How do I pay my electricity bill on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To pay your electricity bill: 1) Go to 'VTU Services' > 'Electricity', 2) Select your electricity distribution company (EKEDC, IBEDC, AEDC, etc.), 3) Enter your meter number, 4) Enter the amount to pay, 5) Confirm. For prepaid meters, your electricity token will be provided instantly. For postpaid, your account will be credited.

entries.question: How do I pay for cable TV on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To renew your cable TV subscription: 1) Go to 'VTU Services' > 'Cable TV', 2) Select your provider (DSTV, GOTV, StarTimes), 3) Enter your SmartCard number (IUC number), 4) Choose your subscription package, 5) Confirm payment. Your subscription is renewed instantly.

entries.question: My airtime/data purchase was deducted but not received
variations: airtime failed but money was taken
entries.answer: If your airtime or data was deducted but not received: 1) Wait 5-10 minutes as network delivery can be delayed, 2) Check your current airtime/data balance on the network, 3) If still not received after 15 minutes, please contact support immediately with the transaction reference number and we will investigate. A refund will be issued if the delivery failed.

entries.question: My electricity token was not delivered
entries.answer: If your electricity token wasn't delivered: 1) Wait 5 minutes (some DisCos take a little time), 2) Check the transaction history on your Arapoint account for the token code, 3) The token is usually also sent via SMS to the phone number linked to the meter. If you still haven't received it, contact support with your transaction reference — we will resolve it promptly.

entries.question: What is Airtime to Cash and how does it work?
entries.answer: Airtime-to-Cash (A2C) is a service where you convert excess airtime into cash credited to your bank account. Here's how it works: 1) Submit an A2C request on Arapoint with the amount of airtime and your network, 2) An A2C agent will give you a phone number to transfer your airtime to, 3) Transfer the airtime using the share-and-sell method (*code# or network app), 4) After confirmation, the cash equivalent (typically 70-80% of airtime value) is sent to your bank account.

entries.question: What is the Airtime to Cash rate?
variations: how much do I get for airtime
entries.answer: Arapoint's A2C rates are: MTN 75%, Airtel 75%, Glo 70%, 9mobile 70% of the airtime value. For example, if you send ₦1,000 MTN airtime, you receive approximately ₦750 cash. Rates may vary slightly based on market conditions and are displayed clearly before you confirm your request.

entries.question: How long does Airtime to Cash take?
variations: when will I receive my cash
entries.answer: Airtime-to-Cash requests are typically processed within 15-45 minutes after the airtime transfer is confirmed. During peak hours, it may take up to 1 hour. Please do not submit a duplicate request while waiting. If your request takes longer than 2 hours, please contact support with your request ID.

entries.question: My A2C request is still pending after a long time
entries.answer: If your A2C request has been pending for more than 2 hours: 1) Check your request status in 'Airtime to Cash' > 'My Requests', 2) Ensure the airtime was successfully transferred to the agent's number, 3) Contact support with your request ID and proof of airtime transfer. Our team will investigate and either process or resolve it.

entries.question: Minimum and maximum amount for Airtime to Cash
entries.answer: The minimum Airtime-to-Cash amount is ₦200 and the maximum per transaction is ₦50,000. For amounts above ₦50,000, please contact support to arrange a bulk conversion.

entries.question: What networks are supported for Airtime to Cash?
entries.answer: Arapoint supports Airtime-to-Cash for all major Nigerian networks: MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile. Simply select your network when submitting your A2C request.

entries.question: How do I transfer airtime for A2C?
variations: how to send airtime for a2c
entries.answer: To transfer airtime for A2C: MTN: *600*recipient_number*amount*PIN# (default PIN: 0000). Airtel: *432*recipient*amount# or Airtel Thanks app. Glo: *131*recipient*amount*1# or Glo Café app. 9mobile: *223*amount*recipient# . After transferring, mark your A2C request as 'Airtime Sent' on Arapoint.

entries.question: How do I fund my Arapoint wallet?
variations: how to add money to wallet
entries.answer: To fund your Arapoint wallet: 1) Go to 'Wallet' > 'Fund Wallet', 2) Select 'Bank Transfer (Payvessel)', 3) A unique virtual account number will be generated for you, 4) Make a bank transfer to that account from any Nigerian bank, 5) Your wallet is credited automatically within 5-15 minutes after the transfer is confirmed.

entries.question: My wallet was not credited after a bank transfer
entries.answer: If your wallet hasn't been credited: 1) Bank transfers via Payvessel typically take 5-15 minutes. Wait at least 15 minutes, 2) Check your transaction history in your bank app to confirm the transfer was successful, 3) Ensure you transferred to the correct virtual account number (it's unique to your profile), 4) If it's been more than 30 minutes and the transfer shows successful in your bank, contact support immediately with the bank transaction receipt — we'll credit your wallet manually.

entries.question: How do I check my wallet balance?
variations: how much is in my wallet
entries.answer: Your wallet balance is displayed on your Arapoint dashboard as soon as you log in. You can also go to 'Wallet' to see your current balance and transaction history.

entries.question: How do I withdraw from my Arapoint wallet?
entries.answer: Currently, wallet funds are used for purchasing services on Arapoint (VTU, identity verification, education services, etc.). Direct withdrawal to a bank account is not available for user wallets. For A2C earnings, cash is sent directly to your bank account. Contact support if you believe funds were incorrectly deposited.

entries.question: My wallet was debited but service was not delivered
entries.answer: If your wallet was debited but the service was not delivered, please contact our support team immediately with: 1) The service you purchased, 2) The amount deducted, 3) The date and time of the transaction, 4) Your transaction reference number. We will investigate and issue a refund to your wallet within 24-48 hours if the service failed.

entries.question: What is my virtual account number?
entries.answer: Your Arapoint virtual account number is generated when you go to 'Wallet' > 'Fund Wallet'. It is a unique bank account number (usually from Payvessel/PalmPay bank) assigned specifically to you. All transfers to this account are automatically credited to your Arapoint wallet. The account number remains the same — save it for future use.

entries.question: How do I register a business name on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To register a business name (BN) on Arapoint: 1) Go to 'CAC Services' > 'Business Name Registration', 2) Provide your proposed business name, business address, and owner's details, 3) Pay the registration fee, 4) Our CAC agent processes the registration with the Corporate Affairs Commission, 5) Your business certificate is delivered digitally within 5-7 working days.

entries.question: How do I register a company (RC) on Arapoint?
entries.answer: To register a company (RC) with CAC through Arapoint: 1) Go to 'CAC Services' > 'Company Registration', 2) Provide company name, directors' details (BVN, NIN, passport photos), business address, and share capital, 3) Pay the applicable fee, 4) Our agent processes the registration end-to-end with CAC, 5) The company certificate (RC number) is delivered within 7-14 working days.

entries.question: How long does CAC registration take?
variations: when will my cac be ready
entries.answer: Business Name (BN) registration typically takes 3-7 working days. Company (RC) registration takes 7-14 working days. Timelines may vary depending on CAC portal availability and document verification requirements. You'll receive updates and notifications as your registration progresses.

entries.question: My CAC registration has been taking too long
variations: why is my cac taking long
entries.answer: CAC registrations can sometimes take longer due to CAC portal downtime or document review requirements. Please check your request status in 'CAC Services' > 'My Requests'. If it has exceeded the stated timeline by more than 3 days, contact our support team with your reference number and an agent will follow up directly with our CAC processing team.

entries.question: What payment methods does Arapoint accept?
entries.answer: Arapoint accepts payments through your wallet balance. To fund your wallet, you can make a bank transfer to your unique Payvessel virtual account number. We do not currently accept direct card payments. All services are paid from your wallet balance.

entries.question: How do I get a refund?
entries.answer: To request a refund: 1) Contact support immediately via this chat or raise a ticket, 2) Provide the transaction reference, amount, and reason, 3) Our team investigates within 24 hours, 4) Approved refunds are credited back to your Arapoint wallet within 24-48 hours. Refunds are issued for failed services where your wallet was charged. We cannot refund completed services.

entries.question: My transaction shows failed but my wallet was debited
entries.answer: This is a priority issue. If your wallet was debited for a failed transaction, please contact our support team immediately. Provide: the transaction reference, the amount debited, the service attempted, and the date/time. We will review and refund your wallet within 24 hours. This is always resolved — your money is safe.

entries.question: How do I view my transaction history?
entries.answer: To view your transaction history: 1) Log in to your Arapoint account, 2) Go to 'Wallet' or 'Transaction History', 3) You can filter by date range, service type, or status. All transactions including wallet funding, service purchases, and A2C payments are recorded.

entries.question: What is a transaction reference?
entries.answer: A transaction reference (or reference ID) is a unique alphanumeric code assigned to every transaction on Arapoint. You can find it in your transaction history or in the confirmation notification you received. When contacting support about a transaction, always provide the reference number — it helps us locate your transaction instantly.

entries.question: I noticed unauthorized activity on my account
variations: my account was accessed without permission
entries.answer: If you suspect unauthorized access to your account: 1) Immediately change your password using 'Forgot Password', 2) Contact our support team immediately — this is treated as a high-priority issue, 3) Our security team will investigate and lock the account while reviewing, 4) Do not share your password or OTP with anyone — Arapoint staff will never ask for your password.

entries.question: Arapoint is asking for my PIN or password
entries.answer: IMPORTANT: Arapoint will NEVER ask for your password, PIN, or OTP through any channel — phone, email, WhatsApp, or any other method. If someone is asking for this, they are SCAMMERS impersonating Arapoint. Do not share any information. Report it immediately to our support team.

entries.question: I did not receive my OTP
entries.answer: If you didn't receive your OTP: 1) Wait 2 minutes — it can be slightly delayed, 2) Check you're using the correct registered phone number, 3) Ensure your phone has network signal, 4) Check if your SMS inbox is full, 5) Click 'Resend OTP' if available, 6) If still not received after 2 tries, contact support — we can manually verify your account.

entries.question: What are education PINs and how do I get them?
entries.answer: Education PINs are scratch card PINs used to check exam results directly on the official WAEC, NECO, NABTEB, or NBAIS portals. You can purchase these PINs on Arapoint: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'Buy PINs', 2) Select the exam body (WAEC/NECO/NABTEB/NBAIS), 3) Select quantity, 4) Pay and receive your PIN(s) instantly.

entries.question: My education PIN is not working
entries.answer: If your education PIN is not working: 1) Ensure you're entering it on the correct official website (e.g., waecdirect.org for WAEC), 2) Check that you selected the correct exam type, 3) If the PIN shows 'already used', it may have been previously scratched — contact support with your purchase reference, 4) If 'invalid', double-check all characters (no spaces, no extra characters).

entries.question: The Arapoint website is not loading
entries.answer: If Arapoint is not loading: 1) Check your internet connection, 2) Try a different browser or clear your browser cache, 3) Try on a different device or network, 4) If the issue persists, Arapoint may be undergoing brief maintenance. Check our social media handles for service status announcements. We typically restore service within 30 minutes for maintenance windows.

entries.question: I keep getting an error message on Arapoint
entries.answer: If you're seeing an error: 1) Note the exact error message and take a screenshot, 2) Refresh the page and try again, 3) Clear your browser cookies and cache, 4) Try using a different browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge), 5) If the error persists, contact support with the screenshot and description of what you were doing — our technical team will investigate.

entries.question: Where can I see Arapoint's service prices?
entries.answer: Service prices are displayed clearly on each service page before you confirm any purchase. You can also find a general price list in the 'Pricing' section on our website. All fees are shown in Nigerian Naira (NGN) and must be paid from your wallet balance.

entries.question: How do I become an A2C agent?
variations: how to be an arapoint agent
entries.answer: To become an Arapoint A2C agent, please contact our support team or send an email expressing your interest. Agent applications require: valid means of identification, a verified bank account, and a minimum activation fee. Agents receive requests from users looking to convert their airtime to cash and earn a commission on each completed transaction.

entries.question: What documents do I need to verify my identity on Arapoint?
variations: what do I need to verify
entries.answer: For NIN/BVN lookups, you only need the 11-digit number — no additional documents are required. For CAC registration, you'll need a government-issued ID (NIN, passport, driver's license) and other documents depending on the service type. All requirements are listed on each service page.

entries.question: How long does a refund take?
entries.answer: Refunds are processed within 24-48 hours after investigation. Once approved, the amount is credited directly back to your Arapoint wallet. You will receive a notification when your refund is completed. If you haven't received it after 48 hours, contact support with your ticket reference number.

entries.question: Can I get a refund for a completed service?
entries.answer: Refunds for fully completed services are generally not available, as we cannot reverse information already retrieved or services already processed on your behalf. Refunds are only issued when the service failed and your wallet was still charged. If you believe there's a special circumstance, contact support and our team will review your case.

entries.question: I need JAMB O-Level upload service
variations: how to upload olevel to jamb
entries.answer: For JAMB O-Level (SSCE result) upload: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'JAMB O-Level Upload', 2) Provide your JAMB registration number, exam body (WAEC/NECO), exam year, and exam number, 3) Pay the processing fee, 4) Our agent uploads your results to your JAMB profile through the CAPS portal. This is needed for admission processing.

entries.question: How do I enroll for NIN if I don't have one?
entries.answer: NIN enrollment is done physically at any NIMC enrollment center or licensed agent. Arapoint provides NIN lookup and verification services, not enrollment. To get your NIN: 1) Visit the nearest NIMC office or licensed enroller with a birth certificate or passport, 2) Complete enrollment and receive your NIN. Once you have your NIN, you can use Arapoint for lookups and vNIN generation.

entries.question: I sent airtime but my A2C request was cancelled
variations: a2c request cancelled after sending airtime
entries.answer: If your A2C request was cancelled after you already transferred the airtime, please contact support immediately with: your request ID, the airtime transfer details (amount, network, recipient number, date), and a screenshot of the transfer confirmation if available. We will investigate and ensure you receive the appropriate cash payment.

entries.question: Tips for using Arapoint smoothly
entries.answer: Tips for using Arapoint: 1) Always fund your wallet before requesting services, 2) Double-check all numbers before submitting (NIN, BVN, meter numbers, phone numbers), 3) Save your transaction references for future reference, 4) Use the transaction history to track all your activities, 5) For time-sensitive services (e.g., JAMB changes), apply well before deadlines.

entries.question: Which electricity companies can I pay on Arapoint?
entries.answer: Arapoint supports all major electricity distribution companies (DisCos) in Nigeria: EKEDC (formerly PHCN, serving Lagos Island), IKEDC (Ikeja Electric), IBEDC (Ibadan), AEDC (Abuja), EEDC (Enugu), KEDCO (Kano), PHEDC (Port Harcourt), BEDC (Benin), YEDC (Yola), JED (Jos), and KAEDCO. Select your DisCo when making payment.

entries.question: Is there a minimum wallet balance required?
entries.answer: There is no minimum wallet balance requirement on Arapoint. You can have any amount in your wallet, including zero. However, you need sufficient balance to cover the cost of any service you wish to use. Fund your wallet based on the services you plan to use.

entries.question: What is the difference between NIN and BVN?
variations: which is better nin or bvn
entries.answer: NIN (National Identification Number) is issued by NIMC and is the primary government identity number for all Nigerians. BVN (Bank Verification Number) is issued by CBN and is specific to banking. NIN is needed for SIM card registration, passports, government services. BVN is used for banking and financial KYC. Both are 11 digits but serve different purposes.

entries.question: Why am I not receiving Arapoint notifications?
entries.answer: If you're not receiving notifications: 1) Check your spam/junk email folder for email notifications, 2) Ensure your phone number is correct in your profile settings, 3) Check that Arapoint's email (no-reply@arapoint.com) is not blocked, 4) Log into your account to see in-app notifications which are always available.

entries.question: What documents do I need for CAC business name registration?
variations: what do I need to register business name
entries.answer: For CAC Business Name (BN) registration, you need: 1) Proposed business name (3 options in preference order), 2) Business owner's full name, 3) Owner's residential address, 4) Nature of business/business activities, 5) NIN and BVN of the owner, 6) Passport photograph, 7) Valid means of identification. Our agent will guide you through the process.

entries.question: Can I do A2C for someone else?
entries.answer: Yes, you can submit an A2C request for someone else's airtime. When submitting, select the correct network and enter the bank account details where the cash should be sent. However, you are responsible for ensuring the airtime transfer is made correctly. Contact support if there are any issues with third-party A2C requests.

entries.question: How do I track my support ticket?
entries.answer: To track your support ticket: 1) Go to 'Support' > 'My Tickets', 2) You can see all your open and resolved tickets, 3) Use your ticket reference number (format: ARP-XXXXXX) to track it. You'll also receive email/SMS notifications when your ticket status changes or an agent responds.

entries.question: How do I escalate my issue to a human agent?
entries.answer: To escalate to a human agent: 1) Type 'agent' in this chat at any time, 2) Click 'Talk to Agent' button if available, 3) Alternatively, rate the AI response as unhelpful and you'll be offered escalation. An available support agent will be assigned to your ticket and will respond as quickly as possible during business hours.

entries.question: What is WAEC GCE and how do I check the result?
entries.answer: WAEC GCE (General Certificate Examination) is conducted for private/external candidates (usually Nov/Dec). To check your GCE result on Arapoint: 1) Go to 'Education Services' > 'WAEC Result Checker', 2) Select 'GCE' as the exam type, 3) Enter your exam number and year, 4) Pay the verification fee and click 'Check'.

entries.question: What JAMB services are available on Arapoint?
variations: what can arapoint do for jamb
entries.answer: Arapoint offers a comprehensive range of JAMB services: Result checking, Admission status check, Change of Course/Institution, Direct Entry (DE) registration, Admission Letter download, O-Level upload to CAPS, Regularization, Mutation, and document uploads. All services are handled by our trained JAMB agents.

entries.question: Is Arapoint legitimate and safe?
entries.answer: Yes, Arapoint is a legitimate, registered Nigerian platform for identity verification and utility services. We process thousands of transactions daily with high success rates. Our platform uses bank-grade security for all transactions. Your personal data is protected and never shared without consent. We are compliant with Nigerian data protection regulations (NDPR).
